oja: [u + jana + kvi.] (thī, pu) CL=7 [Vatāra, ṭī, 2. 141. Attano udayānantaraṃ rūpaṃ janetīti ojā, upubba jana-janane. Aṭṭhasā, yo. 190. Oja + a. Dhātvattha. 36. Ojetitaṃ samaṅgine satte saṅkhāra ca samupa-tthambhati samuttejetīti vā ojā. Nirutti. 556. Ojo. Nirutti. 79. Uju+ṇa. Niti,dhā. 47. Uda + ṇa. Avadhāta + janadhāta + kvi. Ava + jana + kvi. Udayati pasavatīti ojā. Avasaddo vā rakkhaṇe,... Avati janeti cāti ojā. Paramatthadīpanī. 280. Avajanetiti ojā. Anudīpanī. 201. Ojasa (saṃ)] (thī, pu) (1) Ojā. (A) Nutrient (of Kabaḷīkārāhāra) that makes (the body) to be equitable or sufficient. Ojārupa. (B) Ojā that is pathavīrasa, āporasa (which is carried from the root of the tree to the upper place). (C) Fertilizer or soil (that causes to flourish the tree). (Pu) (2) Bright or shine. (3) Power. Ability or quality. (4) Oja guṇa. (5) Articles for use or requisites. Revenue. (6) Radiance. (7) Power and glory.
[oja + ṇa] (ti) CL=7 (The faith, a cause) that is like nutritive essence.
ojadāna: [(1)ojā + dāna. (2) oja+dāna] (na) CL=7 (1) Nutrient donation. Giving nutrients. (2) Giving requisites.
ojadīpa: [oja + dīpa] (pu) CL=7 An island is named Ojadīpa.
ojaja: [ojā + jana + kvi] (ti) CL=7 The physical form that happens due to nutritive essence. Āhārajarupa.
ojasampanda: [ojā + sampanda] (ti) CL=7 Filled with nutritive essence.
ojasi: [yādicchakanāma] (pu) CL=7 A deva is named Ojasi who is a commander (of Vessavaṇa deva).
ojati: [uju + a + ti] (kri) CL=7 (He) is upright or righteous.
ojavanikā: [ava + ju + yu + ā (itthīpaccaññaḥ) yupaccaññaḥkiu anaka pru. ] (thī) CL=7 [Java - nikā=dhāna, ṭī. 298 -See.] A boat or ship is going downstream.
ojavanthu: [oja + vantu. ] (ti) CL=7 [In thī ojavantī. Ojasvata (saṃ)] Having nutrient. (A) (Food, Edible food) with nutritive essence. (Sermon) that is as nutritive as food. (C) With fertile soil. (D) Fulfilled with a cause that is nutritive essence. (C) Noble. Vigorous (Words (sound)).
ojavanī: [ava + ju + yu + ī (itthīpaccaññaḥ.)] (thī) CL=7 A boat or ship is going downstream.
ojaṭṭhamaka: [ojā + aṭṭhamī (aṭṭhamā) + ka] (ti) CL=7 (The form) that is having nutritional essence as the eighth (i.e. the four elements, color, odor, flavor, and nutritive essence).
ojaṭṭhamakarūpa: [ojaṭṭhamaka + rūpa] (na) CL=7 (The form) that is having nutritional essence as the eighth (i.e. The four elements, color, odor, flavor, and nutritive essence).
ojaṭṭhamakarūpuppādana: [ojaṭṭhamakarūpa + uppādana] (na) CL=7 Causes the ojaṭṭhamaka form.
ojaṭṭhamakarūpāharaṇa: [ojaṭṭhamakarūpa + āharaṇa] (na) CL=7 Brings the ojaṭṭhamaka form that has nutritional essence as the eighth (i.e. The four elements, color, odor, flavor, and nutritive essence).
ojaṭṭhāyī: [ojā + ṭhā + ṇī] (ti) CL=7 One who is supported by its vigor or one who is dependent on nutritive essence.
ojināmase: [ava + ji + nā + ma + se (se-kāḥ nipāta. Tanaññaḥ-āguṃ.] (kri) CL=7 (They) will succeed or overcome.
ojita: [yādicchakanāma] (pu) CL=7 One who is named Ojita.
ojjhāpana: [ava + jhe + ṇāpe + yu] (na) CL=7 Causes to see and think by underestimating. Causes to see in the negative side. Denounce.
ojjhāpenti: [ava + jhe + ṇāpe + anti] (kā, kri) CL=7 They cause to be considered as a lower state or underestimate.
ojjhāpeyya: [ava + jhe + kāpe + eyya] (kā, kri) CL=7 (He) should cause to be considered as a lower state or underestimate.
ojoharaṇasākha: [(ojā + āharaṇa. ] (thī, pu) CL=7 [Ojā + haraṇa =] Green and live branches that carry nutrients.
ojābheda: [ojā + bheda] (pu) CL=7 The variety of nutritive essences.
ojāharaṇasākha: [ojāharaṇa + sākha] (thī, pu) CL=7 The branches that carry nutrients. (Green and live branches).
ojāhāranivattana: [ojāhāra + nivattana]  CL=9 Prohibition of nutriment called Ojā.
ojālakkhaṇa: [ojā + lakkhaṇa] (ti) CL=7 Should be perceived as the nutritive essence.
ojānibbattikāraṇa: [ojānibbatti + kāraṇa] (na) CL=7 A cause of arising nutritive essence.

ojāpekkhā: [ojā + apekkhā] (ti) CL=7 Longs for nutrients. Longed for nutrients.
ojāpharaṇa: [ojā + pharaṇakāla] (na) CL=7 A period of suffusion of nutrients.
